steps.prompt:

- **<Competitor>:** [What + why it matters]
- **<Competitor>:** [What + why it matters]

- [1-2 lines of 'this happened but stay the course']

## What I'd test in response (or NOT)
[ONE specific test — OR — explicit 'stay the course, no reaction needed.']

—
*[1-line: most important signal in one phrase.]*

## Banned
- More than 3 flagged competitors (noise)
- 'Why it matters' sections not connected to brief
- Multiple test recommendations

- Consultant-speak
